robot: Unitree G1 humanoid (29 DoF) with two 7-joint arms and Dex1-1 two-finger grippers; NVIDIA's GR00T whole-body controller drives the legs and waist and keeps it balanced

frame.suite: the room (z up; heading 0 along the room's +x axis, counter-clockwise positive)
frame.base_text: on the floor under the pelvis: +X the way the pelvis faces, +Y left, +Z up; it moves with the robot

left.note: 7-joint arm (shoulder pitch, roll, yaw, elbow, wrist roll, pitch, yaw) with a Dex1-1 two-finger gripper

right.note: 7-joint arm (shoulder pitch, roll, yaw, elbow, wrist roll, pitch, yaw) with a Dex1-1 two-finger gripper

torso.note: one value: the torso lean command (rad, + leans forward, -0.2..0.8); the whole-body controller turns it into waist and leg motion (the waist joints in the proprio show the result)

lift.note: one value: the pelvis height command (m, 0.4..1.0; 0.74 at the start); lower squats, which reaches low objects; above about 0.8 m the knees lock and the pelvis stays near 0.78 m; while squatting the controller does not step

locomotion.note: NVIDIA's GR00T whole-body controller walks the robot: it follows the velocity with some lag and wobble, so check base_odometry rather than dead-reckon; a planar speed below 0.055 m/s means standing still (use 0 or at least 0.06); standing still, the base drifts a few centimetres, further while the hands push on furniture or the torso leans far; heights above about 0.8 m lock the knees; squatting (a lower height) reaches low objects, and while squatting it does not step: walk first, then squat in place. It keeps the robot balanced but does not stop it from walking into things.

notes: The arms take joint positions only (no end-effector pose command); each joint's axis and range and each gripper's point between its finger pads are in describe_robot's spec_file (joints, joint_frame, grippers). The servos track with a small error: the measured arm joints sit a little below their targets, by up to a few hundredths of a radian. The torso lean (target torso) and the pelvis height (target lift) are commands to the whole-body controller, which also moves the waist. Time passes only inside calls; the episode has a fixed number of control steps (50 per simulated second; control_steps in every result counts those used, spec_file max_control_steps is the total). A fall (pelvis tilted more than about 53 degrees, or lower than 0.30 m) makes the episode a failure without ending it.
